FREELANCE SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Freelance Services Agreement is made at Pune on this 21st day of May, 2026, between Tanvi Creative Works, a sole proprietorship (hereinafter the "Consultant"), and Brightsail Analytics Pvt. Ltd. (hereinafter the "Client").

INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR STATUS

The Consultant is engaged as an independent contractor and not as an employee of the Client. The Consultant shall be solely responsible for all taxes, professional fees, and statutory contributions arising out of payments made under this Agreement.

SCOPE OF WORK

The Consultant shall design and deliver a brand identity system for the Client, including a primary logo, colour palette, typography, and a brand style guide, substantially as described in Schedule A attached to this Agreement.

DELIVERABLES

The Consultant shall deliver first concept drafts within 14 days of the Effective Date, and shall deliver the final files in both editable and print-ready formats within 30 days of the Client's written approval of the chosen concept.

PAYMENT TERMS

The Client shall pay the Consultant a total fee of Rs. 2,40,000 in three instalments: 30 per cent on signing this Agreement, 40 per cent on approval of the concept drafts, and 30 per cent on delivery of the final files. Each instalment is payable within 15 days of the corresponding invoice, and any delay beyond 30 days shall attract interest at 1.5 per cent per month on the overdue amount.

IP OWNERSHIP

All intellectual property rights in the final approved deliverables shall vest in the Client only after the Consultant has received the final instalment in full. Until such payment, all rights in the work product, including concepts, drafts, and rejected options, shall remain the sole property of the Consultant.

CONFIDENTIALITY

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public business, technical, and financial information of the other party received in connection with this Agreement, and shall not disclose it to any third party during the term of this Agreement or for two years after its termination.

TERMINATION

Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving 15 days' written notice to the other. If the Client terminates without notice, the Client shall pay for all work completed up to the date of termination, together with 25 per cent of the fee attributable to the unfinished portion of the current milestone.

LIABILITY

The Consultant's total liability arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees actually paid by the Client under it. In no event shall the Consultant be liable for indirect or consequential losses, including lost profits or lost business opportunities, howsoever arising.

GOVERNING LAW

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India, and the courts at Pune shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising out of or in connection with it.
